title: The Phantom of Heilbronn: A DNA Trail That Never Existed
description:
For sixteen years, one woman's DNA turned up at over forty crime scenes across three countries — stolen cars, syringes, burglaries, even a child's toy gun. German police dubbed her the Phantom of Heilbronn and put a 300,000-euro bounty on her head, linking her to six murders. Then in 2009, her DNA showed up on a burned male corpse. That's when the truth cracked open.

The 'phantom' never existed. Investigators traced the DNA back to a single factory in Austria, where the cotton swabs used for crime-scene collection had been contaminated on the production line by a female worker. Sixteen years of investigation, gone in a week. But one case tied to the phantom was painfully real — the 2007 murder of 22-year-old policewoman Michèle Kiesewetter, shot point-blank in Heilbronn. Her killer has never been found, and her stolen service weapon later turned up in the ashes of a neo-Nazi hideout hundreds of miles away.
